Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: 1. Region is Palangka Raya City.

2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs which are the authority of the autonomous region.

3. Mayor is the Mayor of Palangka Raya.

4. Regional Apparatus hereinafter abbreviated as PD is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and Regional House of Representatives in administering government affairs which are the authority of the Region.

5. Protection of women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing security in fulfilling their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.

6. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.

8. Woman is a person of female sex.

9. Child is a person who is not yet 18 (eighteen) years old and has not married, including an unborn child.

10. Community is individuals, community groups, including parents and families.

11. Prevention is all efforts to eliminate all risks and adverse impacts of violence against women and children.

I 11

12. Child-Friendly City hereinafter abbreviated as KLA is a Community that is conducive to developing all social psychological potentials of a person optimally.

13. Child Obligations are everything that must be carried out by children according to the function and role of children.

14. Forum for Handling Victims of Violence Against Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as FPK2PA is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is tiered at the city and sub-district levels.

15. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service center in efforts to empower women in various fields of development, as well as protect women and children from various types of discrimination, and acts of violence, including trafficking in persons established by the regional government or community-based.

16. Child-Friendly Village hereinafter abbreviated as KRA is the development of a village area that unites the commitment and resources of the village government involving the community and business community located in the village in order to promote, protect, fulfill and respect children's rights, which are planned consciously and sustainably.

Article 20

(l) The Regional Government is obliged and responsible to implement prevention efforts against violence against Women and Children as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (3) letter e and paragraph (4) letter i carried out in the form of:

a. collecting data and organizing information systems for the Protection of Women and Child victims of violence;
b. conducting education on anti-violence values towards Women and Children; and
c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the empowerment of Women and the Protection of Child victims of violence.

(2) The Regional Government is obliged and responsible to provide and organize services for victims in the form of:

a. establishing and organizing technical service institutions for victims by involving community elements; and
b. encouraging public awareness of the importance of protection for victims of violence.

Article 33

(1) Reporting as referred to in Article 32 paragraph (5) serves as consideration material for the Mayor in making policy decisions on the implementation of the Protection of Women and Child Victims of Violence.

(2) The implementation report of the Protection of Women and Child Victims of Violence as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out 1 (one) time in 1 (one) year or at any time if necessary.

Article 27

(1) In order to protect and guarantee the rights of Women and Children from violence, FPK2PA is established.

(2) FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of: a. Regional FPK2PA;

b. Sub-district FPK2PA; and

c. Village FPK2PA.

(3) The establishment of Regional FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a is determined by the Mayor. I II

(4) The establishment of sub-district FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b is determined by the sub-district head. (5) The establishment of Village FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c is determined by the village head. (6) Further provisions regarding FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated in a Mayor Regulation.

Article 31

(1) The Mayor is obliged to conduct guidance and supervision of Child Victims of Violence.

The Protection of Women and

(2) The implementation of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Protection of Child Victims of Violence.

I 11

(3) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:

a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training;
d. monitoring and evaluation; and
e. reporting.
(4) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) to realize the objectives of the Protection of Women and Children in accordance with the norms, standards, procedures and criteria implemented by the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection.
(5) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out with professional and transparent principles.
(6) In carrying out guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection is obliged to report regularly to the Mayor.
(7) In the case of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (2), the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection may cooperate and coordinate with other Regional Apparatuses, the community, other agencies and/or organizational institutions.

Article 32

(I) Evaluation of the Protection of Women and Child Victims of Violence is carried out based on service implementation documents, empowerment, prevention, fulfillment and monitoring results of the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children.

I II

(2) The implementation of evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection.

(3) Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) includes process, impact and results evaluation.

(4) The results of the evaluation as referred to in paragraph (3) constitute material for the Mayor to prepare a report.

(5) Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (4) is carried out at least 1 (one) time in 1 (one) year.

(6) Further provisions regarding evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Mayor Regulation.

Article 7

(1) The forms of services for Protection of Women as referred to in Article 6 letter a include: a. legal assistance;

b. health services;

c. social rehabilitation services; d. complaint, consultation and counseling services; e. social reintegration services; and

f. pre-marriage guidance services.

I 11

(2) Pre-marriage guidance services as referred to in paragraph (1) letter f, are implemented for every woman who will enter into marriage.

(3) Guidance is conducted as referred to in paragraph (2) to provide understanding and knowledge regarding family resilience, health, psychology, religion, social and culture.

(4) Guidance as referred to in paragraph (3) is implemented by the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women Empowerment and Child Protection.

(5) In implementing guidance as referred to in paragraph (4) the Regional Apparatus may involve: a. relevant agencies;

b. religious leaders; and

c. traditional leaders.

(6) Further provisions regarding minimum service standards for protection of Women are regulated by Mayor Regulation.

Article 29

Enhancement of family participation in the Protection of Women and Child Victims of Violence is carried out through: a. prevention of marriage at the age of Children;

b. bringing Women closer to health services; and

c. strengthening family resilience.

Article 34

Funding for the implementation of the Protection of Women and Child Victims of Violence is sourced from:

a. regional revenue and expenditure budget; and b. other legal and non-binding sources in accordance with the provisions of the Laws and Regulations.

Article 10

(1) Monitoring is implemented in the form of observation, identification, and recording of the implementation of Protection of Women.

(2) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is conducted by the Protection of Women and Children coordination team through coordination forum activities.

(3) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) produces data and information regarding the implementation of fulfillment of Women's rights.

(4) The monitoring results as referred to in paragraph (3) constitute material for the Mayor to conduct evaluation.

Article 19

(1) In order to ensure the effectiveness of the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children, the Regional Government must conduct cross-sectoral coordination with relevant institutions.

(2) In the implementation of coordination for the Protection of Women and Children as referred to in paragraph (1) the Mayor shall establish a coordination team for the Protection of Women and Children.

(3) In the coordination forum activities as referred to in paragraph (2) the Protection of Women and Children coordination team has the task of: a . preparing materials needed related to the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children;and

b. delivering results, obstacles, and solutions undertaken to overcome obstacles in the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children.

I 11

(4) The coordination forum as referred to in paragraph (3) is conducted periodically, at least 2 (two) times in 1. (one) year.

Article 2

Protection of Women and Children is organized based on the principles: a. respect, fulfillment, protection, advancement, and enforcement of rights; and b. legal certainty.
